purpose: Make the same statement for two alternative conditions.
keywords: N + であれ + N + であれ
The ceremony will take place whether it is sunny or rainy.
Students and working adults alike may apply.
Whether you agree or disagree, I want to hear your reasons.
formation: N + であれ + N + であれ
restrictions: Pairs parallel categories; neither changes the conclusion.
mistake: It does not mean that both alternatives happen simultaneously.
